<!-- One topic per pull request. / Satu topik setiap pull request. -->

## What and why / Apa dan kenapa

## Evidence / Bukti

- [ ] `npm run gate` passes / lulus
- [ ] A change to a signature check or `confirmPayment` comes with a test that fails without it / Perubahan pada semakan tandatangan atau `confirmPayment` disertai ujian yang gagal tanpanya
- [ ] Docs changed in English and Bahasa Melayu together / Dokumen diubah dalam BI dan BM bersama
- [ ] No keys, secrets or customer data anywhere / Tiada kunci, rahsia atau data pelanggan

### Adding a gateway (CONTRIBUTING.md) / Menambah gateway

- [ ] Official docs read in full, date noted / Dokumen rasmi dibaca penuh, tarikh dicatat
- [ ] Fake first, then adapter; conformance suite passes / Fake dahulu, kemudian adapter; set keakuran lulus
- [ ] `info.evidence` is `docs`, or `measured` with a real sandbox run (and differences recorded) / `docs`, atau `measured` dengan larian sandbox sebenar (beza direkod)
